parsedVerdict.reasoning: All seven files serve one concern: the HTTP request and response DTOs for the identity module (users and addresses). The unit still fails because two rules are written out in more than one place. (1) The role-code format regex /^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$/ is copied into AssignRoleDto and ListUsersQueryDto, and the two copies already have different error messages. (2) UpdateAddressDto repeats every field and validator from AddAddressDto, only adding @IsOptional to each, instead of being derived from it. If either rule changes, several files must be edited by hand. Smaller consistency issues: update-address.dto.ts imports AddressType with an 'src/...' path while the other address DTOs use a relative path, and AddressResponseDto types its timestamps as Date while the user response DTOs use ISO strings.

violations.message: The role-code format regex /^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$/ on AssignRoleDto.roleCode is also in ListUsersQueryDto, with a different message. It should be defined once and reused.
ListUsersQueryDto.roleCode repeats the role-code regex from AssignRoleDto instead of using a shared definition.

UpdateAddressDto repeats every address field and validator from AddAddressDto instead of being derived from it (e.g. PartialType/OmitType). It also imports AddressType with an 'src/...' path, unlike the other address DTOs.
